highlights.title: Stereo Multistage Spatial Attention for Real-Time Mobile Manipulation Under Visual Scale Variation and Disturbances
highlights.summary: 提出面向实时移动操作的双目多阶段空间注意力预测策略，以提升尺度变化和视觉扰动下的闭环动作生成鲁棒性。

highlights.summary: 论文探索冻结文本预训练Transformer权重跨模态复用，并在机器人操作基准上用少量可训练接口取得性能提升。

highlights.title: E$^2$DT: Efficient and Effective Decision Transformer with Experience-Aware Sampling for Robotic Manipulation

highlights.title: World Model for Robot Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
